messages:
maria: Heads-up — today's nightly scanner run started failing after the RBAC change to the KMS role. Trivy jobs are spitting `KMSDecryptDenied` and Snyk connectors are timing out.

sam: Confirmed on eu-west-1 and us-west-2. GHAS webhook runs show identical errors. Crash loopback for the scanner init container.

leo: Minimal logs: `error decrypting key: access denied`. Looks like the new policy removed `kms:Decrypt` for the scanner service account by accident.

aya: @maria any recent secret rotation? could be token + kms combo causing GHAS token refresh to fail.

maria: No manual rotation. Change landed in infra PR #432 (rbac: tighten kms role). Probable principle of least privilege regression.

sam: Quick mitigation idea: flip scanner to use fallback local key for decrypts while we patch RBAC. Set `SCANNER_USE_LOCAL_KEY=true` in the scanner chart and redeploy? Minimal blast radius but we lose centralized key audit.

leo: Agreed as short-term. Also propose to add a CDN for suppression rules sync so Snyk doesn't need KMS decrypt during start.

aya: I'll open a small PR to add the env flag and a helm value. keeping it behind feature flag.

maria: Good. For the longer fix we should update the infra role to explicitly allow `kms:Decrypt` for the `scanner-service` principal and add an automated test in our deploy pipeline to simulate decrypt.

sec-bot: Alert: 3 services failed KMS decrypt in last 10m (trivy-scan, snyk-worker, gha-sync). Incident created: INC-2026-089.

sam: Who can own contacting infra to roll back the RBAC change? @eng-infra? leo can you take point?

leo: I can ping infra and paste logs. Also will add an immediate allow rule and a tight condition on resource ARN, not broad.

maria: Triage checklist: 1) Add fallback flag PR (aya) 2) Infra temporary allow + test (leo) 3) Re-run nightly scans and confirm suppression mapping intact (sam) 4) Postmortem note about RBAC change gating (maria)

aya: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/helm/compare/patch-scanner-fallback-PR435 — includes docs for enabling local key.

leo: Infra acknowledged, applying scoped `kms:Decrypt` for scanner principal now. Will notify when done.

sam: After infra patch, I see Trivy workers come back up. Re-running full scan now.

maria: When scan completes, check for missed suppressions and any duplicate CVE noise. If suppression sync ran during failure we might need to reconcile state with suppr-tool.

sam: Scan finished — small flood of composite false positives from the failed window, but suppression mapping re-applied. No new critical CVEs introduced during outage.

maria: Great. Action items: (1) infra to ship a unit test that runs a pretend decrypt during role apply, (2) add a deploy guard that blocks RBAC changes without that test, (3) keep `SCANNER_USE_LOCAL_KEY` as an emergency toggle for 48h then remove. I'll write the postmortem.

leo: Adding to infra backlog and will follow up with a short RFC for RBAC deploy tests.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-089 marked RESOLVED by leo.

maria: Thanks all. One more: let's add a dashboard panel for KMSDecrypt error rate under "Redwood Security -> Scanner" so we catch regressions earlier.

aya: I'll add the dashboard tile and link to the postmortem doc.

sam: Closing out thread after the postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
